gaps: Bootstrap snapshot uses the last committed Actions sample; refresh is scheduled by the existing daily collector.
Nested workflow_run, reusable-workflow, and job-needs edges are UNKNOWN until the first live source scan completes.
Workflow count comes from the generated catalog snapshot and will refresh with the collector.
honesty_rules: Workflow definition count is distinct from enabled workflows, observed workflows, runs, jobs, and billed minutes.
Run observations are a bounded API sample with page and call bounds preserved in sources.sampling.
Public standard hosted-runner minutes are free; runtime values are operational measurements, not private-repository billing attribution.
A missing run observation is UNKNOWN, not zero.
Nested edges are parsed from workflow source text; unresolved and ambiguous names remain visible.
